_: WHO DOES A TASK, once - read by the server (taskuary/kinds.py) and the page (website/src/kinds.js). A task's Kind decides which machinery works it: `task` is the owner's own list (nothing starts on it), `general` and `coding` are the two an agent works (the two that reach the Board), `reply` is a drafted answer approved before it goes. `label` is the kind's name on the task list and the task page's picker, `hint` what the picker says under it in plain words (the audit, 2026-10-17: no repositories, CLIs or models), `verdict` what triage's panel calls the destination, `worker` who works it in a sentence ("Start the coding agent"), `made` whether the new-task dialog offers it (a reply is never made by hand), `triage` whether triage may name it. A brain is a tool and a profile is instructions (the owner, 2026-10-15) - a kind names neither.
shown_: WHO THE OWNER SEES AT WORK (the owner, 2026-10-28: 'the agent should just say Taskuary but the profile inherits from it'). A profile is the instructions an agent runs under, never its name: a general agent signing the owner up for things read 'researcher asked you something'. Every screen, phone line and notification names an agent by `shown`; a coding run may name its tool where the caller knows it; the profile is told only on hover ('Instructions: researcher') and edited in Settings.
